§6Wohr:§r Minecraft fog-ʔa normal.

May cause issues other mods fog.

ƛiyuu fog start?

  '0.0': Fog start player position. '1.0': fog-start circle-lod render distance square.
'1.414': lod render distance square-fog-start circle.

ƛiyuu fog end?

  '0.0': Fog end player position. '1.0': fog-end circle-lod render distance square.
'1.414': lod render distance square-fog-end circle.

Minimum fog thickness?

  '0.0': No fog. '1.0': full fog color.

Maximum fog thickness?

  '0.0': No fog. '1.0': full fog color.

ƛiyuu fog thickness calculated?

LINEAR: Linear distance (ignore 'density') EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(distance*density)) EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((distance*density)^2))

ƛiyuu height fog.

SPHERICAL: camera distance. CYLINDRICAL: horizontal distance. MAX: max(heightFog, farFog) ADDITION: heightFog + farFog
MULTIPLY: heightFog * farFog INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
LIMITED_ADDITION: farFog + max(farFog, heightFog)
MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + farFog * heightFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
AVERAGE: farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5

ƛiyuu height fog located?

ABOVE_CAMERA: camera-sky. BELOW_CAMERA: camera-void. ABOVE_AND_BELOW_CAMERA: both. ABOVE_SET_HEIGHT: set height-sky. BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: set height-void. ABOVE_AND_BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: set height-both.
Set height, what is height position?

ƛiyuu start height fog offset?

  '0.0': No offset. '1.0': entire world height. (Include depth)

ƛiyuu end height fog offset?

  '0.0': No offset. '1.0': entire world height. (Include depth)

Minimum fog thickness?

  '0.0': No fog. '1.0': full fog color.

Maximum fog thickness?

  '0.0': No fog. '1.0': full fog color.

ƛiyuu height fog thickness calculated?

LINEAR: Linear height (ignore 'density') EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(height*density)) EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((height*density)^2))
